The vehicle features six speakers that deliver clear audio, while auxiliary USB inputs enable seamless device connectivity. Electronic messaging assistance, both with read function and voice operation, keeps you informed without distraction, ensuring your drive remains safe and engaging. The 2018 Jeep Compass Performance Features Designed for off-road capability, this Compass features an electronic 4WD selector that allows for quick and easy terrain adjustments. Its rear locking differential enhances traction in challenging conditions, while the tuned off-road suspension provides stability and comfort on rugged surfaces. The 4WD system operates on demand, automatically engaging when needed to optimize efficiency and performance, making this SUV a versatile choice for both city driving and outdoor exploration.

This well-equipped 2025 Mazda CX-50 2.5 S Preferred Package in Gray represents a thoughtful choice for drivers seeking a reliable compact SUV that balances capability and everyday practicality.

- 4-Wheel Drive with All-Wheel Drive capability
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Blind-Spot Monitors for enhanced awareness
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Power driver seat with adjustable positioning
- Power Liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Automatic temperature control with dual-zone front A/C
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- 17-inch aluminum alloy wheels
- Rear backup camera
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Rain-sensing wipers
- MAZDA CONNECT emergency communication system

The CX-50 features a SKYACTIV 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering 25 city MPG and 31 highway MPG. This engine delivers dependable performance while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency for daily commuting and weekend adventures alike. The all-wheel-drive system provides confidence in varied weather and road conditions throughout the year.

Inside, the cabin emphasizes comfort and connectivity. Heated front seats warm you on cold mornings, while the dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger reach their preferred temperature. The power driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position, and the leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to your daily drives. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone seamlessly integrated with the vehicle's 8-speaker audio system.

Safety technology is woven throughout the CX-50's design. Blind-spot monitors provide real-time awareness when changing lanes, while the backup camera displays what's behind you during parking maneuvers. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work continuously to keep the vehicle stable. Dual front airbags, side airbags, overhead airbags, and knee airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection.

Adaptive Cruise Control takes the fatigue out of highway driving by automatically maintaining your set distance from the vehicle ahead. The power liftgate opens automatically when you approach with your key, simplifying loading and unloading cargo. Rain-sensing wipers activate when moisture is detected, and auto High-beam Headlights adjust your beam between high and low automatically for optimal visibility and courtesy to other drivers.

With thoughtful engineering, practical features, and a 6-speed automatic transmission that balances efficiency and responsiveness, this CX-50 is ready to handle whatever your routine demands. Black wheel locks provide security for the distinctive carbon flash wheels.

Beyond performance, this Corvette prioritizes your awareness and safety. The head-up display keeps essential information in your line of sight, while HD cameras front and rear combined with rear cross traffic alert technology provide comprehensive visibility. Side blind zone alert adds another layer of assurance when changing lanes or navigating tight spaces.

The convertible hardtop transforms this Corvette from open-air cruiser to enclosed coupe, offering flexibility for any season or occasion. Memory functions for both driver and passenger seats, along with power lumbar controls, ensure comfort is never compromised regardless of who's driving. The universal home remote and wireless charging for devices integrate modern convenience into every drive.

This Corvette represents an opportunity to own a modern American icon with minimal use, comprehensive warranty protection, and straightforward financing available. We invite you to experience the combination of performance, technology, and style this Stingray offers.

description:
This is a nice 1999 Ford Mustang Cobra with the 4.6L V-8 and manual 5 speed transmission. Carfax report shows no damage and is available. A previous owner had a Pro Charger supercharger, Borla exhaust, and additional guages for boost, water temp, and oil pressure installed on the Mustang. I bought this car in 2023 and kept collector car insurance on it while I have owned it. I garaged it and drove it around town every few months.
The car is in good condition for a 27 year old car. The interior is in excellent condition, and the body is very straight. There are a few scratches at the edge of a door and on the driver side of the front bumper. The paint shows well from 10 feet, but upon close inspection, it has the typical imperfections of a 27 year old black paint job. There are some swirl marks around the car, and light fading beginning on the roof, hood, and other small areas. It could benefit from a buff and polish.
I see absolutely no sign of rust on the car. It starts well and runs strong. The air conditioning blows extremely cold and all power windows and seats work.
Aside from the paint issues mentioned above, the only issue I am aware of is that the coolant light is on. It has been this way since I bought the car, but the car does not seem to run hot. I have not driven this Mustang as a daily driver and usually only put 5-10 miles on it when I drive it around, and I have not done any out of town trips. I am not sure how it handles longer highway trips.
Pricing for anything associated with Cobra have risen dramatically in the last several years. The 1999 Mustang Cobra presents a good value and an excellent way to get into the Mustang Cobra scene without paying the stratospheric prices associated with other year models. This car is a hoot to drive and has the sound and all the power you want. It can throw you back in your seat while you run through the gears. Don't miss an opportunity to grab a very clean, well presenting Cobra before pricing on these rises.

This model comes equipped with the Equipment Group 202A High Package, featuring:

- EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD

Three rows of seating accommodate your entire family, while the flexible third row and split-folding rear seat adapt to your cargo needs. The climate control system features automatic temperature management with front and rear zones, ensuring everyone stays comfortable on longer journeys. Driver-focused conveniences include memory settings for the driver seat and steering wheel, power-adjustable features throughout, and multiple USB ports with USB-C connectivity in the cargo area.

Pre-collision assist with autonomous emergency braking, forward collision warning, and dynamic brake support work together to help protect occupants. The exterior parking camera rear provides visual confirmation when backing, while the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensitive steering deliver controlled handling across various driving conditions.

The power panoramic roof floods the cabin with natural light, while the power sunshade offers privacy and climate control when needed. Rain-sensing wipers adjust automatically to weather conditions, and the all-terrain tires grip confidently whether you're on highway or unpaved roads. description:
Purchased new in April 2026. All windows are tinted, and the exterior color is Anvil with Perma Plate protection. Absolutely no defects and in excellent condition. This is the highly sought-after Rubicon trim with the trail-rated package and suspension system. It rides super smooth and has yet to see dirt. Heated steering wheel and seats for the winter months. Premium alloy wheels and just shy of 33" tires. Four auxiliary switches are already professionally installed for add-ons or accessories.

Professionally upgraded sound system to larger and amplified speakers, to include a subwoofer installed into the trunk space that is easy to disconnect or move around. The sound system is loud with the roof back and doors off while traveling. Back windows can be easily taken off and stored in carry-bag that can be stowed in the trunk. What makes this Rubicon special is the highly sought-after one-touch button sky system that retracts the roof completely with one press of a switch. This Rubicon is super easy to go doors off, windows off, and roof back to have the open-air Jeep riding vibe.

Doors are super easy to take off with a one-clip system and no tools needed. I can take and stow all doors in under 10 minutes. Interior is in new condition and is still holding the new car smell. Aftermarket mirrors are provided for when riding with doors off. The vehicle is located in Albany, GA. The only reason for selling is due to life priorities. I have other vehicles, and although I love this Jeep, I have other things to focus on.

Absolutely new condition, and my selling price is well below the dealership price point, plus fees and markups by the dealer. I have babied this Rubicon so far. Warranty on the mechanical and end-to-end bumper will still apply. If interested, send a message with phone-number and I will reach out directly. Vehicle sale will have to take place in-person at a Robbins FCU location, as the current lienholder. I will report scamming attempts.

This 2023 Ford Bronco Badlands represents a powerful combination of capability and refined comfort, built to handle demanding terrain while delivering premium interior appointments.

- 2.7L V6 Twin Turbocharged EcoBoost engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- SASQUATCH PACKAGE with 17 black high-gloss aluminum wheels and LT315/70R17 mud-terrain tires
- High-clearance suspension with position-sensitive Bilstein shock absorbers
- Ford Performance heavy-duty modular front bumper
- Carbonized gray molded-in-color hard top with rear-window defroster and washer
- 12 LCD capacitive touchscreen with SYNC 4 and connected built-in navigation
- B&O sound system by Bang & Olufsen with 10 speakers and subwoofer
- Equipment Group 334A Lux Package including Ford Co-Pilot360 safety technology
- Adaptive cruise control with lane-keeping system and evasive steering assist
- Pre-collision assist with automatic emergency braking and pedestrian detection
- Blind spot information system with cross-traffic alert
- Front row heated seats with 10-way power driver and 8-way passenger adjustment
- Leather-trimmed bucket seats with MOLLE strap system and armrest storage
- Dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control
- Wireless charging pad and 2 smart charging USB ports
- Heated steering wheel with remote keyless entry
- Towing capability for your adventure needs

With 16,406 miles, this Bronco Badlands has been carefully maintained and remains well within normal usage parameters. The gray exterior finish provides a modern aesthetic that pairs seamlessly with the premium interior appointments throughout the cabin.

The SASQUATCH PACKAGE elevates this model with purposeful off-road enhancements, including high-clearance fender flares and a 4.7 final drive ratio engineered for challenging terrain. The mud-terrain tires and Bilstein shock absorbers work together to provide both capability and controlled responsiveness on varied surfaces.

Inside, the dual-zone climate control and front heated seats ensure comfort across changing conditions, while the SYNC 4 system with connected navigation keeps you oriented whether you're on marked trails or exploring new routes. The B&O sound system transforms your drive with premium audio clarity, and the wireless charging pad eliminates the need for tangled cables.

Safety systems integrated throughout this vehicle include blind spot monitoring, cross-traffic alert, and pre-collision assist with automatic emergency braking. The 360-degree camera system provides complete visibility awareness, crucial for navigating tight spaces and challenging off-road passages.

The hard top provides weather protection and enhanced security, while the modular front bumper reflects purposeful design built for genuine capability. Additional sound deadening throughout the cabin creates a refined driving environment even during extended journeys.

This Bronco Badlands combines serious capability with the daily comfort and technology that modern drivers expect. We invite you to schedule a visit so you can experience the quality of this vehicle firsthand.

description:
This 2027 GMC Terrain Denali delivers a refined driving experience with premium styling and thoughtfully integrated features designed for your daily journeys.

- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto
- Navigation System with OnStar and GMC connected services
- Perforated Leather-Appointed Seat Trim with heated and ventilated seats
- Heated steering wheel and heated door mirrors
- 6-Speaker Premium GMC Infotainment System with SiriusXM
- Remote keyless entry and security system
- Fully automatic and auto high-beam headlights with rain sensing wipers
- Front fog lights and body-color bumpers
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control
- 19" Midnight Silver Aluminum wheels
- 8-way power driver seat with memory and lumbar adjustment
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Emergency communication system with OnStar capability
- Dual front impact airbags and comprehensive safety features
- Power liftgate and split folding rear seat

The Terrain Denali is powered by a 1.5L DOHC engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering 24 city and 26 highway mpg. This efficient powertrain is complemented by all-wheel drive capability, ensuring confident handling across varying road conditions. Whether navigating city streets or highway drives, this drivetrain balances responsiveness with practical fuel economy.

The interior reflects Denali's commitment to comfort and luxury. Perforated leather seating with heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats provides year-round comfort, while the heated steering wheel enhances cold weather driving. The heated rear seats extend that consideration to all passengers. An 8-way power driver seat with memory settings and 2-way lumbar adjustment allows you to find your ideal driving position quickly.

Technology integration is seamless with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, allowing intuitive smartphone integration without cables. The integrated navigation system keeps you oriented, while OnStar and GMC connected services provide added peace of mind. SiriusXM satellite radio with a 360L trial subscription delivers entertainment options, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep focus on the road.

Safety systems work quietly behind the scenes. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with electronic stability control and traction control provides secure handling. The vehicle includes dual front and side impact airbags, occupant sensing technology, and overhead airbags. Speed-sensing steering and brake assist round out a comprehensive safety framework designed to protect you and your passengers.

The exterior presents a commanding presence with 19" Midnight Silver Aluminum wheels, front fog lights, and a body-color spoiler. Power door mirrors and heated mirror glass add practical convenience, while fully automatic headlights and rain-sensing wipers adapt to driving conditions. The power liftgate provides hands-free cargo access.

This white 2027 GMC Terrain Denali awaits your test drive. Contact our sales team to schedule an appointment and experience the combination of capability, comfort, and technology this vehicle offers.

description:
This 2022 BMW X5 xDrive40i delivers the combination of luxury, performance, and capability you're looking for in a premium midsize SUV.

- 20" V-Spoke Alloy Wheels with Run-Flat Tires
- Parking Assistance Package with Surround View and 3D View
- Premium Package with Remote Engine Start and Gesture Control
- Climate Comfort Package with 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Heated Front Seats with Armrests and Heated Steering Wheel
- Front and Rear Heated Seats
- Head-Up Display
- Hi-Fi Sound System with 10 Speakers and SiriusXM
- Live Cockpit Pro with Navigation System
- ConnectedDrive Services and BMW TeleServices
- Leather Steering Wheel and Shift Knob
- Power Moonroof
- Trailer Hitch
- Drive Recorder
- Dual-Zone Climate Control with Auto Temperature Management

The exterior presents a refined appearance in Arctic Grey Metallic, complemented by the carefully designed body-color bumpers and integrated roof rack with rails. The 20-inch V-spoke wheels with 275/45R20 run-flat tires provide both aesthetic appeal and practical durability for varied driving conditions.

Inside, you'll find a sophisticated cabin finished in Vernasca leather upholstery that reflects BMW's commitment to premium materials. The power front seats with lumbar support and memory settings adjust to your preferences, while the heated front seats with armrests ensure comfort during colder months. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of driver-focused comfort. The rear seat center armrest and split-folding rear seats offer flexibility for passengers and cargo management.

The 3.0L I6 TwinPower Turbo engine paired with the 8-speed automatic Sport transmission delivers responsive performance through the available AWD system. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering work together to provide composed handling whether you're navigating city streets or highway driving.

The Parking Assistance Package takes the guesswork out of tight spaces with Active Park Distance Control, Surround View with 3D View, and Parking Assistant Plus. The rear view camera and drive recorder add layers of awareness and documentation during your journeys.

Climate control extends throughout the cabin with four-zone automatic climate management, ensuring every passenger maintains their preferred temperature. The front and rear heated seats provide welcome warmth during cold-weather driving.

This X5 xDrive40i combines everyday practicality with the refinement and attention to detail BMW owners expect. We invite you to visit our showroom and take this vehicle for a comprehensive test drive to experience its capabilities firsthand.

description: This 2023 Audi Q7 45 Premium quattro represents a sophisticated choice for discerning drivers who value both capability and refinement in their three-row SUV.- Navarra Blue Metallic exterior with 20 5-Spoke Turbine-Design wheels- Convenience Package with Heated Steering Wheel and Adaptive Cruise Assist w/Lane Guidance- Audi Phone Box with Wireless Charging and signal booster- Topview Camera System with virtual 360-degree view for enhanced visibility- Towing Package with 4,400 lbs capacity and Tow Hitch Receiver- Audi MMI Navigation plus with Touch Response- Audi Beam Rings LED lighting on front and rear doors- Panoramic power moonroof- Premium leather seating with heated front seats- Three-row seating configuration with reclining third-row bench- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning- Audi Guard All-Weather Mats (front and rear set with Q7 logo)- Audi Sound System with 10 speakers and SiriusXM 360LThe 2.0L 4-Cylinder TFSI engine delivers capable performance with the security of quattro all-wheel drive, achieving 19 city and 25 highway miles per gallon. The 8-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic provides seamless power delivery whether navigating city streets or highway stretches. This powertrain combines efficiency with the dependable engineering you expect from Audi.Your comfort matters. Heated front bucket seats, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control ensure that every journey feels tailored to your preferences. The panoramic moonroof floods the interior with natural light, while the leather steering wheel and genuine wood door panel inserts reflect the premium materials throughout the cabin.Safety and convenience work together in this Q7. The Topview Camera System provides a virtual 360-degree view during parking and low-speed maneuvering, while the Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance helps manage highway driving. Four-wheel disc ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive airbag system support your confidence on the road.The Towing Package demonstrates this SUV's versatility, with a 4,400 lbs towing capacity and integrated 7-pin connector ready for your trailer. Whether you're hauling recreational equipment or expanding your weekend possibilities, this capability is engineered into the frame.We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this Q7 firsthand. Our team is ready to discuss financing options and answer your questions about this well-equipped luxury SUV.

The 4-zone automatic climate control ensures personalized comfort for all occupants.

Technology features enhance both safety and convenience. The head-up display projects vital information directly into your line of sight, while the surround view camera system provides comprehensive visibility around the vehicle. Active driving assistant and forward collision warning with pedestrian detection add an additional layer of security. The navigation system integrates seamlessly with enhanced USB and Bluetooth connectivity for smartphone integration.

The exterior reflects M Sport styling with its aerodynamic kit, shadowline exterior trim, high-gloss roof rails, and distinctive M double-spoke 20-inch alloy wheels wrapped in performance run-flat tires. Glacier silver metallic paint showcases the athletic proportions. LED adaptive headlights with automatic high beams and high-intensity retractable washers ensure optimal visibility in all conditions.

This 2018 Honda Civic EX represents reliable transportation backed by Honda's reputation for quality and durability. The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that suits any setting, whether commuting or weekend travel.

The Civic EX delivers practical fuel economy, achieving up to 40 miles per gallon on the highway and 31 in the city. This efficiency makes the vehicle an economical choice for daily driving without sacrificing performance. The responsive 2.0-liter engine provides adequate power for both highway merging and city navigation.

Inside, the cabin offers comfort and convenience features that enhance daily driving. The reclining front bucket seats with front center armrest provide comfortable seating, while the split folding rear seat offers flexibility for cargo or passengers. Automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin environment, and the power moonroof adds natural light and an open feeling to the interior.

Technology integration keeps you connected on the road. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility allows seamless smartphone integration, while the premium SiriusXM-capable audio system with eight speakers delivers quality sound. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands off the wheel, and the trip computer displays useful driving information.

Safety features provide peace of mind during every journey. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags, along with an occupant sensing system. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and ABS brakes work together to help maintain vehicle control, while the exterior parking camera assists with rear visibility.

Additional conveniences include heated power door mirrors, fully automatic headlights with delay-off function, speed-sensitive wipers, and illuminated entry. The compass and outside temperature display add practical utility to your drive.

This Civic EX combines Honda dependability with practical features for drivers who value efficiency and everyday functionality. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand.

This 2018 Dodge Grand Caravan SXT offers practical family transportation with a spacious interior designed for comfort and convenience.

- Navigation

- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera

The Grand Caravan features a 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 6-Speed Automatic transmission, delivering practical performance for everyday driving. With an EPA rating of 17 MPG city and 25 MPG highway, this minivan balances capability with reasonable fuel efficiency. The gray exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements various driving environments.

Interior comfort is a priority in this vehicle. The front dual zone climate control allows driver and passenger to maintain individual temperature preferences, while rear air conditioning keeps all occupants comfortable. The power 8-way driver seat with 2-way lumbar support ensures an adjustable driving position for long journeys. Premium seats featuring suede inserts add a touch of refinement to the cabin.

Connectivity and convenience features integrate seamlessly into your daily routine. The Uconnect system with voice command and Bluetooth allows hands-free phone calls and audio streaming. The 6.5" touchscreen display provides access to navigation functionality, making trip planning straightforward. Remote start capability means you can begin warming or cooling the vehicle before entering.

Safety is addressed through a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain vehicle stability in various conditions. The ParkView rear back-up camera and brake assist system contribute to confident operation in parking situations and general driving.

Seating flexibility defines the Grand Caravan's practicality. The 2nd row Stow'N Go bucket seats fold away when not needed, creating additional cargo space. The 3rd row split-bench seat is fully reclining, accommodating varying passenger configurations and storage requirements. This adaptability makes the vehicle suitable for families with changing transportation needs.

This 2018 Grand Caravan SXT combines accessibility with the features families expect from a modern minivan. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and see how this vehicle meets your transportation requirements.

This exceptionally spacious and highly optioned 2024 Ford Expedition XLT 4X4 brings an elite standard of full-size family utility, refined passenger comfort, and state-of-the-art glass cockpit technology to our selection here at Bill Luke, family-owned and proudly serving our community since 1927. Well-engineered to conquer family road trips and heavy towing duties with effortless composure, it is driven by the muscular 3.5L EcoBoost V6 twin-turbo engine, paired to a smooth 10-speed automatic transmission with SelectShift and an Intelligent 4WD system featuring a Terrain Management System with customizable drive modes. This flagship SUV makes a clean, commanding statement on the road wrapped in classic Iconic Silver Metallic paint, beautifully accented by crisp LED reflector headlamps, rugged black roof-rail crossbars, and 18-inch machined aluminum wheels with magnetic-painted pockets.

Inside the massive Black Onyx interior, passengers travel in a first-class sanctuary across an upgraded 8-passenger cabin layout, featuring upgraded premium ActiveX seating surfaces. Thanks to the highly desirable, high-value Equipment Group 202A (High Package), the cabin treats the driver and front passenger to heated and ventilated power bucket seats with memory settings, a heated steering wheel, power-adjustable pedals, and a wireless phone charger. Configuring cargo space is entirely effortless thanks to the optional power-folding 2nd-row tip-and-slide 40/20/40 bench seat working alongside a PowerFold® third-row split bench. The tech-heavy command center is anchored by an expansive 12-inch center touchscreen display with the SYNC® 4 system, wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto , an 8-inch driver productivity cluster, and a universal garage door opener. Complete with standard active driver assistance, featuring a Blind Spot Information System (BLIS), Lane-Keeping System, and Pre-Collision Assist with emergency braking. This ultimate full-size cruiser delivers total connected authority on every daily commute or long-distance expedition.
